signals.description: `Submodule.LinearDisjoint.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat`, `Submodule.LinearDisjoint.rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat`: if `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, if one of `M` and `N` is flat, then any two commutative elements contained in the intersection of `M` and `N` are not `R`-linearly independent (namely, their span is not `R ^ 2`).
